movement: A46 strictly weakens the main primitive-factor sufficient witness gate. The preceding review retained a rational-only elliptic qualification in Q-COMPOSITE-PRIMITIVE-BRIDGE and Q-GEOMETRIC-PRIMITIVE-BRIDGE. A46 removes it for every characteristic and genus>=2, using any pointed geometrically cyclic odd-degree cover prime to p with actual rational primitive p-primary torsion zero. Geometric rank zero is no longer needed to remove that qualification, and the deck group need not be constant.
not_counted_as_movement: A42 density does not force a prescribed finite transfer fibre to meet the detectable locus.
A43 strengthens an already refuted forcing row, with further examples.
A44 and its odd-tower probe identify additional obstacles without proving universal cover incidence.
New labels, A45 example, source citations, whole-proof checks, compilation, packaging and checkpoint saving are not by themselves main-gate movement.
next_steps: Attack universal existence of a pointed rational primitive-factor unit, with the all-characteristic A46 criterion as the current sufficient witness.
Determine whether conditional Hooley prime supply can be connected to actual curve-specific primitive-factor incidence; do not infer incidence from density.
Complete checked A45 integration and a matched paper build as required documentation, without counting it as main-gate movement.
